payout_quote: The incentive amount of $100 for the 'referrer' (Existing Member) and $400 for the 'referee' (New Member) is subject to change. Incentives will be paid within 14 business days of meeting active checking requirements for six (6) consecutive months. Six months start 30 days after account creation date.
steps: Find a current Consolidated Community Credit Union member (Portland, OR area) who is not in your household and ask them to refer you; the referee cannot be a member of the same household as the referrer

Open a new Apex Checking account as a new member (never an owner/signer on any CCCU account or loan); enroll in eStatements and Online Banking and set up a payroll, Social Security, or pension direct deposit within 30 days of account opening

Each month for 6 consecutive months (starting 30 days after account creation): keep the account enrolled in eStatements, receive a payroll/SS/pension direct deposit, log in to CCCU online banking at least once, make at least 10 debit transactions (ATM excluded), and never overdraw the account
The $400 incentive is paid to the new member (and $100 to the referrer) within 14 business days of completing the six consecutive months
catches: REFERRAL-GATED: you must be referred by an existing CCCU member who is not in your household; CCCU employees, friends, and family members are excluded
Long grind: 6 consecutive months of monthly direct deposit + 10 debit transactions + monthly login with zero overdrafts before any payout
Membership is limited to people who live, work, own a business, attend school, or worship in Multnomah, Washington, or Clackamas counties, OR (or relatives of current members)
Must be 18 or older; new members only (never had a CCCU account or loan)
Cannot be combined with any other CCCU offer; the CU can modify or cancel the program without notice
Bonus over $10 is subject to IRS 1099-INT reporting
biggest_catch: You must find an existing CCCU member outside your household to refer you, then hit monthly activity requirements for 6 straight months before the $400 pays out.
eligibility: New members only (never an owner/signer on a CCCU account or loan), 18+, OR tri-county field of membership; must be referred by an existing member in good standing who is not in the same household.
timing: Enroll in eStatements/online banking and set up direct deposit within 30 days of opening; meet all active-checking requirements for 6 consecutive months; incentive paid within 14 business days of completion.
weasel_words: reserves the right to modify or cancel this program without notice
